About

Dwayne Kilvington is a Leeds-born, London-based composer, producer and multi-instrumentalist. His work moves across jazz, electronic music and contemporary composition, bringing improvisation, club-influenced production and cinematic writing into one flexible identity. It grew out of collaboration in DIY and community music scenes.

Highlights

  • Composer, producer and multi-instrumentalist
  • Roots in DIY and community music scenes
